persona: Embedded engineer turned ISO 26262 safety engineer
resumeText:
Arjun Deshpande | Pune | arjun.deshpande@example.com

EXPERIENCE
Functional Safety Engineer, Sahyadri Mobility Systems, Pune (2021 - present)
- Performed HARA for an electric power steering ECU and assigned ASIL ratings to hazards under ISO 26262.
- Derived safety goals and wrote the functional safety concept for the steering torque path.
- Ran DFMEA and FMEDA workshops with hardware and software teams.
- Linked safety requirements to design and test cases in IBM DOORS.
- Presented safety analysis results to customer safety managers in monthly reviews.
- Supported an ASPICE Level 2 assessment by preparing software work products.

Embedded Software Engineer, Deccan Auto Electronics, Pune (2018 - 2021)
- Developed embedded C drivers for brake ECU sensors following MISRA C.

SKILLS
ISO 26262, FMEDA, DOORS, Embedded C, CANoe

EDUCATION
BE Electronics and Telecommunication, College of Engineering Pune, 2018
